2026-09-08T14:43:43.690Z.name: BCH After School Club
2026-09-08T14:43:43.690Z.description: The official utility token of the BCH After School Club, a very chill study club under the Supreme Student Council (2026–2027) at AMA Computer College - Naga Campus. $AFTER holds no monetary value and was minted mainly to give students hands-on exposure to the Bitcoin Cash network. Members earn $AFTER (which acts like point rewards) by attending weekly after-school study sessions and completing quick BCH quizzes, then use their accumulated tokens to bid in monthly budget-meal auction game.
